description: Botanic EXO (Vegan) is a plant-derived exosome skin and scalp booster from Korea, formulated for professional aesthetic use alongside microneedling and energy-based devices. It pairs plant extracellular vesicles with peptides, amino acids and hyaluronic acid to support skin repair and rejuvenation. It is supplied as a two-part system (lyophilized concentrate plus an activating solution) that is reconstituted immediately before treatment.
howItWorks: Plant-derived exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate fibroblast and keratinocyte activity, helping to calm inflammation and stimulate dermal regeneration. Reported activity includes support for fibroblast migration, keratinocyte activation and collagen production to accelerate skin repair. Delivery of the active cargo is enhanced when the product is combined with microneedling or fractional laser.
composition: Plant-derived exosomes (reported as LEXosome / Lithospermum erythrorhizon exosome) with peptides, amino acids, vitamins, shikonin, glutathione and hyaluronic acid (reported composition).
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage. Reconstitute the lyophilized concentrate with the activating solution and use promptly after mixing. Pair with microneedling, fractional laser or LED to improve uptake of the active components. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction before offering to patients.
features: Two-vial lyophilized powder plus activating solution
Peptide, amino acid and hyaluronic acid adjuncts
Designed for microneedling and laser pairing
benefits: Vegan, non-animal positioning for patient preference
Fits existing microneedling and laser workflows
Freshly activated per treatment for consistency

description: Botanic Shine (Whitening) is a plant-exosome brightening booster and microneedling serum from Korea, built on tomato-derived exosomes and tomato callus extract. It targets uneven tone, dark spots and dullness while supporting skin regeneration. It is supplied for professional use with microneedling or transdermal delivery.
howItWorks: Tomato-derived exosomes act as signalling vesicles that help regulate melanocyte and fibroblast activity, supporting a more even tone while calming inflammation. Reported brightening adjuncts such as glutathione and niacinamide complement the exosome signalling to reduce the appearance of pigmentation. Uptake is improved when applied with microneedling or laser.
composition: Tomato-derived plant exosomes (extracellular vesicles) and tomato callus culture extract with NAD+, glutathione, niacinamide, a botulinum-like peptide and hyaluronic acid (reported composition).
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage and use promptly after opening or reconstitution. Pair with microneedling or laser to drive uptake of the brightening actives. Advise concurrent sun protection, and confirm regulatory status and permitted claims in your jurisdiction.
features: High-concentration tomato extract and callus-derived vesicles (as reported)
benefits: Targets a high-demand brightening and pigmentation segment

description: 2XSome is a Korean exosome skin and scalp booster supplied as a dual-vial system: a lyophilized exosome powder and an activating diluent that are mixed immediately before use. It is intended for professional aesthetic delivery to support skin regeneration, barrier function and post-procedure recovery.
howItWorks: Exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate fibroblast and keratinocyte activity, helping to reduce inflammation and stimulate regeneration. The activating diluent carries peptide and nucleotide adjuncts intended to support the skin barrier and enhance exosome uptake. Effect is improved when combined with microneedling or injector delivery.
composition: Lyophilized exosome powder with sodium hyaluronate, activated by a diluent containing hydrolyzed collagen, sodium DNA (polynucleotide), copper tripeptide-1 and vitamins (reported composition).
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage. Reconstitute the exosome powder with the activating diluent and use promptly. Pair with microneedling, mesotherapy or fractional laser for uptake. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction; supplied for licensed practitioner use.

description: Exo'One (Exo One) is a Korean professional exosome skin-rejuvenation booster derived from stem-cell exosomes, supplied as a two-vial system (a lyophilized exosome vial plus a solution vial) reconstituted before use. It is positioned to support skin regeneration, elasticity, hydration and barrier strength. A vegan variant, Exo'One V, uses Korean ginseng-derived exosomes.
howItWorks: Stem-cell-derived exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate fibroblast and keratinocyte activity, helping to calm inflammation and stimulate regeneration. Collagen and hyaluronate adjuncts support hydration and skin structure. Uptake is improved when combined with microneedling or laser.
composition: Stem-cell-derived exosomes (Pure EXO) with high concentrations of collagen / hydrolyzed collagen and sodium hyaluronate (reported composition). The Exo'One V variant uses Korean ginseng-derived plant exosomes.
usageNotes: Store refrigerated (manufacturer states 2-8 C) and use promptly after reconstitution. Pair with microneedling, mesotherapy or fractional laser to improve uptake. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction before offering to patients.
features: Two-vial lyophilized powder plus solution format
Cold-chain (2-8 C) with long stated shelf life
benefits: Integrates with microneedling and booster services

description: ASCE+ HRLV is ExoCoBio's exosome solution for scalp rejuvenation and hair-loss support, produced with the company's proprietary ExoSCRT isolation and purification technology. It is supplied as a lyophilized exosome vial reconstituted before scalp delivery and is used in professional hair-restoration protocols, often alongside microneedling or as an adjunct to other therapies.
howItWorks: Exosome signalling vesicles modulate the follicular micro-environment, delivering growth-factor and miRNA cargo that helps calm scalp inflammation and support hair follicle activity. This signalling is intended to promote a healthier scalp and follicle regeneration. Delivery is enhanced when combined with microneedling.
composition: ExoCoBio exosomes purified via proprietary ExoSCRT technology, supplied as a lyophilized powder reconstituted before use; reported to carry growth-factor proteins and anti-inflammatory miRNAs.
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage. Reconstitute the lyophilized powder with the supplied diluent and use promptly. Deliver into the scalp with microneedling or an injector for uptake; commonly used across a course of sessions. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction.
features: Designed for microneedling and injector delivery
benefits: From ExoCoBio, a documented exosome manufacturer
Integrates with microneedling and PRP-style protocols
indications: Hair thinning and androgenetic alopecia support

description: ASCE+ SRLV-S is ExoCoBio's exosome-based skin-rejuvenation kit, produced with ExoSCRT purification technology and supplied as a lyophilized exosome vial plus a diluent mixed immediately before use. It is used in professional skin-booster and post-procedure protocols to support regeneration, elasticity and radiance.
howItWorks: Exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate fibroblast and keratinocyte activity, helping to reduce inflammation and stimulate regeneration and brightening. A multi-active adjunct complex supports hydration, antioxidant defence and skin structure. Uptake is improved when combined with microneedling or mesotherapy.
composition: ExoCoBio exosomes (ExoSCRT technology) with a reported adjunct complex including NAD+, retinol, ascorbic acid, glutathione, copper tripeptide-1, palmitoyl peptides, amino acids and coenzymes. Some regional formulations are marketed as Rosa damascena (rose) callus-derived / vegan; confirm the exact variant with the supplier.
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage. Reconstitute the exosome powder with the diluent and use promptly. Pair with microneedling or mesotherapy for uptake; commonly used across a course of sessions. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction.
benefits: From ExoCoBio, a documented exosome manufacturer

description: Crystal Tomato is a skin-brightening product built on colourless carotenoids (phytoene and phytofluene, branded PhytoflORAL) from specially cultivated non-GMO tomatoes; it is not an exosome product. It is best known as an oral whitening supplement, paired with L-cysteine to support glutathione, and is positioned for pigmentation and even-tone support. Verify the specific presentation (oral supplement versus any injectable offering) with the supplier.
howItWorks: Colourless carotenoids act as internal photoprotectants, absorbing UV and infrared wavelengths and helping to regulate melanin production to reduce hyperpigmentation and support an even tone. L-cysteine supports endogenous glutathione, contributing to the brightening effect. This is an antioxidant and photoprotective mechanism, not exosome cell-signalling.
composition: Colourless carotenoids (phytoene and phytofluene / PhytoflORAL) from non-GMO tomatoes, with L-cysteine (reported composition). Not an exosome product.
usageNotes: Supplied primarily as an oral supplement; follow label dosing and storage. Effects on pigmentation are gradual and typically build over weeks of consistent use. It is a cosmetic/dietary brightening aid, not a drug; confirm regulatory classification and permitted claims in your jurisdiction, and advise concurrent sun protection.
benefits: Addresses high-demand pigmentation and whitening segment
Non-invasive oral adjunct to in-clinic tone services
Systemic support complementing topical and laser brightening

description: Hairna Exosome Hair Fill is a Korean exosome-based scalp and hair booster supplied in a pre-filled syringe, combining exosomes with biotin, peptides and growth-factor adjuncts. It is used in professional hair-restoration protocols to condition the scalp and support follicle health and hair growth.
howItWorks: Exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate the follicular micro-environment, helping to calm scalp inflammation and support hair follicle activity. Biotin, peptides and reported growth-factor adjuncts complement this signalling to nourish the scalp and follicles. Uptake is improved when delivered with microneedling or an injector.
composition: Reported to contain stem-cell-derived exosomes (ASC and RSC exosomes), copper tripeptide-1, biotin, panthenol, biotinoyl tripeptide-1 and growth-factor adjuncts such as FGF2 (reported composition). Presentation: pre-filled syringe.
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage and use promptly. Deliver into the scalp with microneedling, an MTS device or injector for uptake; commonly used across a course of sessions. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction.
benefits: Combines exosomes with established scalp actives

description: Hairna Exosome Booster Ampoule is a Korean topical scalp treatment delivering a high reported concentration of exosomes to strengthen the scalp and support hair. It is supplied as ampoules and packaged with microneedle (MTS) caps to aid transdermal penetration during professional or guided take-home protocols.
howItWorks: Exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate the follicular micro-environment, helping to calm inflammation and support hair follicle health. Scalp-nourishing adjuncts complement the exosome signalling to improve keratin, elasticity and hair tensile strength as reported. The included MTS microneedle caps improve penetration of the actives into the scalp.
composition: Exosome-based ampoule (reported at approximately 4% / 37,200 ppm exosomes) with scalp-nourishing adjuncts (reported composition). Supplied with MTS microneedle caps for delivery.
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage and apply promptly after opening. Use with the supplied MTS microneedle caps (or a microneedling device) to drive uptake; typically applied as a multi-vial course. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction.
benefits: Suits in-clinic and guided home protocols
indications: Weak hair and reduced tensile strength

description: Hanheal Hair (Hanheal Exosome Hair Filler) is a Korean injectable/mesotherapy preparation from BNC Global for hair and scalp concerns, combining exosomes with peptides, PDRN and hyaluronic acid. It is supplied as lyophilized exosome vials with solvent vials, reconstituted before scalp delivery to support follicle regeneration and stronger hair growth.
howItWorks: Exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate the follicular micro-environment, helping to calm scalp inflammation and support hair follicle activity. Peptides and PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) provide regenerative support, while hyaluronic acid aids hydration. Uptake is improved when delivered with mesotherapy or microneedling.
composition: Growth-factor-bearing exosomes with peptides, PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) and hyaluronic acid (reported composition); supplied as a lyophilized exosome vial plus a solvent vial reconstituted before use.
usageNotes: Maintain cold-chain storage. Reconstitute the exosome vial with the solvent vial and use promptly. Deliver into the scalp with mesotherapy, an injector or microneedling; commonly used across a course of sessions. Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction.
benefits: From an established Korean manufacturer (BNC Global)

description: Hanheal Facial (Hanheal Exosome Facial Rejuvenation) is a Korean exosome skin-booster from BNC Global, blending exosomes with hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, polynucleotides and peptides. It is supplied for intradermal delivery via mesotherapy gun, hydra-pen or microneedling to support regeneration, elasticity and texture.
howItWorks: Exosomes act as signalling vesicles that modulate fibroblast and keratinocyte activity, helping to calm inflammation and stimulate regeneration. Polynucleotides and peptides provide additional regenerative support while niacinamide and hyaluronic acid aid tone and hydration. Uptake is improved when delivered with microneedling or a mesotherapy device.
composition: Exosomes with hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, polynucleotides (PN/PDRN) and peptides (reported composition).
usageNotes: Store per the manufacturer's label (stated 1-30 C); many exosome products require refrigeration, so confirm the cold-chain requirement for this SKU and use promptly after reconstitution. Deliver intradermally via mesotherapy gun, hydra-pen or microneedling (typically a course of 3-5 sessions). Confirm regulatory status and permitted use in your jurisdiction.
features: Exosome, PN, peptide and niacinamide formula
For mesotherapy gun, hydra-pen or microneedling
benefits: From an established Korean manufacturer (BNC Global)
